title: How much will Eagles draft picks play in 2026?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: How much will Eagles draft picks play in 2026?
sources.description: The Eagles have been on quite a run in the NFL draft and they hope they did it again in 2026. In recent seasons, the Eagles have been playing their rookies more and more. The Eagles traded up three spots from No. 23 to No. 20 — giving up a pair of fourth-round picks — to draft Lemon out of USC.
